Subject: Initial MSA + Order Form (draft) — kickoff request

Hi Michael,

Thanks for taking this forward — attached are a draft MSA (redline turned off) and an initial Order Form for the pilot. A few things we want to align on before we go into formal redlines:

- Signature authority: our legal team needs to confirm who on Redwood can execute the Order Form (name & title) to match our procurement workflow.
- Template preference: we usually prefer to keep counterparty-specific SOWs inside the Order Form; confirm if Redwood prefers Exhibits instead.
- Technical bounds: the SOW references a 99th percentile latency goal — can your team confirm the model variant/hosting region expected for the pilot?

Can we schedule a 30-minute kickoff tomorrow? I'm available 10–12 PT. Attaching the files for your intake: Apex_SOW_v1.docx; OrderForm_Draft.pdf (attachment stubs).

Thanks,
Lila

Hi Lila — thanks for sending and for the clear ask. Looping in Kimberly (legal) and Marissa (contracts ops) to run the intake.

Quick answers up front:
- Signature authority: we typically execute Order Forms by our VP of Finance or Chief Revenue Officer depending on value and term. Kimberly, can you confirm the title we should list for Apex's countersignature?
- Template: Redwood prefers Order Form-level SOWs for pilot work, but can accept an Exhibit model if Apex requires it for procurement. We'll note that in the kickoff.
- Technical bounds: our default pilot will run on hosted US-west with a standard latency profile; I'll confirm model variant after Kimberly/Infra sign-off.

Proposed time: Fri 2027-03-05 10:30 PT. If that works I'll send a calendar invite and attach a short intake checklist.

Thanks,

Michael / Marissa — thanks for the ping. Quick intake notes after a first pass on the attachments:

1) Party & signature: RDW should list "Redwood Inference, Inc." with signature block for "Chief Revenue Officer (CRO)" for the Order Form execution path at pilot-level value. If contract value or term expands, we escalate to the CFO. Please confirm whether Apex needs an exec-level signer name or title-only is acceptable.

2) Security evidence: Apex references SOC2 equivalency in the SOW. We need to ask Apex which controls map to the listed categories (availability, confidentiality). I'll request a brief evidence packet (SOC2 summary, any specific protocol exceptions).

3) SOW placement: We can accept the SOW as an attachment to the Order Form provided the exhibit language clarifies deliverables, acceptance criteria, and the latency measurement methodology (p99 measured from Redwood edge to Apex endpoints). Suggested clause additions are in comment bubbles (see Apex_SOW_v1.docx).

4) Redline priority: "liability cap" and "data residency" are priority items for Legal. Lower priority: IP assignment for ephemeral logs.

5) Timeline: if we take the kickoff tomorrow we can produce a first redline pass in 3 business days.

I'll prepare a short intake checklist to include in the invite.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
